From the arcade

Lights Out

Every switch affects its neighbours. Can you turn the whole board dark?

Play Lights Out →

How to play

  1. Click a square to switch it and its immediate neighbours above, below, left and right.
  2. A bright square is on; a dark square is off. Make the entire board dark.
  3. Clicking the same square twice cancels that change. The order of your switches does not matter.
  4. All three starting patterns are solvable. Restart repeats the pattern; Next puzzle changes it.

Try to use as few moves as possible. There is no timer.
